RUS.scope: Russian Federation federal budget revenue, 1996 federal budget law (No. 228-FZ): revenue 347.2tn and expenditure 435.75tn rubles, deficit 88.55tn; 5000 rubles per US$. Line split below the law's headline totals is estimated.

mechs.name: Value-added tax
mechs.note: VAT at 20% (10% on food and children's goods), principal federal revenue. Estimated share of the revenue total.

mechs.name: Profit tax
mechs.note: Enterprise profit tax, 35% (federal share about 13% with rest to regions).

mechs.name: Excise taxes
mechs.note: Excises on spirits, tobacco, cars, petroleum, gas.

mechs.name: Foreign trade duties
mechs.note: Export duties on oil and gas plus import duties.

mechs.name: Non-tax and other revenue
mechs.note: Non-tax revenues, CBR profit transfers, privatization and other receipts. Remainder to the law's 347.2tn.
